claim: Try it with sample data opens a separate demo that never changes real data.
sandbox: real pasted CSV, then /demo; assert separate IndexedDB names, reset, and Start for real preserves the real draft

claim: The free sample workflow makes requests only to this product origin.
sandbox: fresh browser context on /demo; record every request during the populated sample flow

claim: CSV imports accept documented header aliases, quoted fields, and a default quantity of one.
sandbox: fresh root page; paste aliased CSV with a quoted comma and blank quantity; assert a printable one-label run

claim: Only CSV files up to 2 MB are accepted.
sandbox: fresh root page; choose a non-CSV file and a 2 MB plus one byte CSV; assert recovery messages

claim: EAN-13 and UPC-A checksums are checked before printing.
sandbox: fresh root page; import one invalid EAN-13 and one valid UPC-A, then correct the EAN-13 and assert printable state

claim: Code 39 and Code 128 subset B values are checked before printing.
sandbox: fresh root page; import valid Code 39 and Code 128 rows, then make Code 39 lowercase and assert the actionable error

claim: The A4 30-up layout prints through the browser print dialog.
sandbox: demo sample; trigger Print label run, emulate print media, assert one 210 mm sheet with nine generated labels

claim: A run receipt records the printed source, SKU count, and label count in local history.
sandbox: demo sample; print receipt only, open Run receipts, and assert the visible receipt facts

claim: Run receipts export and restore as a JSON backup, including from the empty state.
sandbox: fresh root page; import a valid receipt JSON, open restored Run receipts without a CSV, then trigger export

claim: Free runs print up to 150 labels while CSV checking and receipt backup stay free.
sandbox: fresh root page; import a valid 151-label row, attempt receipt print, and assert upgrade state while core controls remain enabled

claim: You can delete an individual run receipt.
sandbox: demo sample; create one receipt, confirm deletion, and assert the empty receipt archive

claim: License verification runs at most once per day and never blocks free work.
sandbox: fresh root page with a fixture license verdict; mock the verify response, assert no daily duplicate and usable CSV import

claim: The populated demo opens after the network disappears once the app has loaded.
sandbox: dedicated fresh browser context; load /demo under service-worker control, set offline, reload, and assert the sample remains

claim: The service worker caches the app shell, illustration, and legal pages.
sandbox: dedicated fresh browser context; wait for service-worker control and inspect cached request paths
